author: marici.Strominger

checks.statement: every nonempty augmentation has rational rank one
pairwise residue relations have primitive integral coordinates
adding depths updates the index only by gcd refinement
Bezout reduction gives a saturated integral kernel basis for every audited row
the first cross-depth residue circuit is primitive (2,-1)
reference-pair circuits can miss the saturated kernel by index five
the even-start rising-product fixed divisor has only the predicted 2-adic correction
the stable residue index is Catalan transport times the constructor fixed divisor
depths through 2g stabilize the index and isolate the even-constructor 2-adic memory

verdict: The positive tower family maps by one weighted residue augmentation. Every nonempty family has rational rank one. Its integral image index is the gcd of the Catalan residue characters; adding depths refines this index by gcd. Sequential Bezout reduction supplies a saturated integral kernel basis. Pairwise circuits remain valid but can span a proper sublattice, with an explicit index-five falsifier at grade three depths 4,6,8.
